name: Noise-TS-TW
title: Film Grain Noise
blurb: Animated film grain overlay that refreshes every few frames at a configurable…
description: Canvas 2D-rendered random noise texture that updates periodically, creating a flickering film grain effect across the entire viewport.
use_when: Cinematic or nostalgic aesthetic, adding texture to video backdrops or adding visual depth to solid-color backgrounds.
avoid_when: Accessibility-sensitive contexts or low-bandwidth scenarios — continuous canvas updates consume battery and bandwidth.
a11y: Passive visual overlay; pointer-events: none so it does not intercept interactions. No keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
